fonts.display: 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Fragment Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

palette.name: Vermillion
palette.role: Orange accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Peach Hairline
palette.role: Orange outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Cream Vellum
palette.role: Page canvas below the hero, input borders, soft surface washes — the warm paper stock everything else sits on

palette.name: Bone White
palette.role: Card surfaces, button fills on the orange hero, nav text on dark/orange, inverted typography — the bright surface layer

palette.name: Midnight Ink
palette.role: Primary headings, body text, dark section backgrounds, chat bubble fills, button borders on light — the heavy type and the rare full-bleed dark band

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Card borders, secondary text, muted UI rules — the mid-neutral that softens edges between Bone White and Midnight Ink

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.role: Link text on light surfaces, image strokes, secondary borders

palette.name: Ochre Tan
palette.role: Badge backgrounds and borders, secondary surface tint — a warm neutral tag fill that sits between cream and peach

palette.name: Press Black
palette.role: Icon fills, tight border accents, true-black for print-style contrast moments
